BL-999 — BL-969's standing guard asserts a heavy test's timeout is PRESENT, never that it is ADEQUATE - so two siblings on the same derive+render path still carry 45000ms after one was measured failing at 48926ms under load 77, and the guard stays green while they flake
What it solves: Source: coder note 20260820T163148Z_000391, "burndown sibling+fixture budgets flake under load 40-80 - data in BL-969 commit". The data is in `9ff014998`'s message and is reproduced above rather than left as a pointer, since that commit is on the cleaner's branch (`bbedde169`) and not yet on `main`…
Approval context: One judgement is mine and worth a look: I scoped this to strengthen the guard, not just to raise two numbers.
Bumping 45000 to 90000 in two places is a five-minute fix and would end the flake today. I have written the ticket to also change the guard from "a timeout is present" to "a timeout covers …
BL-999 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-999" (or "reject BL-999 <reason>") to act.
